entities.name: Ryusei
entities.description: The great divine dragon of Kamigawa's mountains who guarded Sokenzan.

entities.name: Jugan
entities.description: Original protector of the orochi, resurrected by ritual.

entities.name: oni
entities.description: Attackers during the Shattered States Era.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War after which only Ryusei survived among spirit dragons.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: Place where the dragon egg was sealed.

events.summary: After the Kami War Ryusei is the only spirit dragon left alive.
events.quote: Ryusei was the only spirit dragon to remain alive

events.summary: The orochi resurrect Jugan, and Jugan and Ryusei defeat the oni incursion.
events.quote: together Jugan and Ryusei defeated the oni incursion

events.summary: Jugan collects the other dragons' essences and she and Ryusei sleep in an egg sealed in Boseiju for fifty years.
events.quote: The egg was sealed into the heart of Boseiju , where it was nurtured for fifty years.

events.summary: The five dragons hatch, reborn in new forms; Ryusei becomes Atsushi.
events.quote: His new form was that of Atsushi , the Blazing Sky .

relations.quote: together Jugan and Ryusei defeated the oni incursion
